Grandma's Chicken Noodle Soup

The soup that fixed every cold in our house for forty years.

Prep: 15 minutes · Cook: 45 minutes · Serves 6

Ingredients

  • 1 whole chicken (about 4 lbs)
  • 3 carrots, sliced
  • 3 stalks celery, chopped
  • 1 yellow onion, diced
  • 8 oz egg noodles

Directions

  1. Cover the chicken with water and simmer with aromatics for 45 minutes.
  2. Pull the chicken, strain the broth, and shred the meat.
  3. Simmer the vegetables in the broth, add noodles and chicken, and cook until tender.
